name: teamline
description: Teamline – chat, workgroups, calls, calendar and files for companies

scripts.dev: npm run setup -w server && concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run setup -w server && npm run start -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
